coverage.summary: Just cause protection applies to units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance, regardless of construction date. These include most pre-1980 multifamily units, new construction with a certificate of occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes, rooming houses, most condominiums and government-owned or -subsidized units. Only the exempt categories are excluded.
coverage.owner_conditions: A Golden Duplex is exempt while an owner lives in one unit, provided the duplex was also owner-occupied on Dec. 31, 1979. The shared kitchen/bath exemption applies only if the landlord lived on the property at the start of the tenancy.

result.notes: Several values were removed because no document supports them. supersedes_state_rule (true) is now null: no document mentions Cal. Civ. Code § 1946.2 or the relationship between Berkeley's ordinance and the state just-cause rule. other_conditions is now null: the § 1946.2(i) statement is unsupported, and the remark that qualifying households are undefined is a documentation gap, not a coverage condition. owner_occupied_exemption_max_units (2) is now null: the Golden Duplex exemption also requires owner occupancy on Dec. 31, 1979, so a general 2-unit owner-occupied exemption would overstate it; the condition is kept in owner_conditions instead. The summary was lightly reworded. D006 describes new construction as having a certificate of occupancy 'after 1980', while D009 says 'after June 1980'; the summary follows D009. construction_cutoff stays null because both pre-1980 and post-1980 units are covered for just cause.
